notes.title: Patch 1.2.2
notes.content: [p]This update expands the “Remaster” of Dice or Die with a brand-new journal system to track discoveries and adventure progress, the first wave of Steam achievements, and important fixes for cursor and trigger issues.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]📖 New Features[/h3][list][*][p][b]Journal System[/b]: Keep track of your discoveries and follow your journey across the island with a dedicated in-game log.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam Achievements[/b]: Unlock rewards for your milestones and survival feats.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🐞 Bug Fixes & Stability[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed cursor display issues occurring in certain cases.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected several trigger malfunctions affecting gameplay flow.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.2.1
notes.content:
[p]With Patch 1.2.1, we continue the momentum of the “Remaster” introduced in version 1.2.0.
This update further refines optimization, improves combat and loot balance, and brings key narrative and visual enhancements.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🔧 Optimization & Performance[/h3][list][*][p]Further improved optimization thanks to better GPU/CPU load balancing.[/p][/*][*][p]Visual upgrades, especially noticeable in interior environments.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed cursor display issue on 4K resolutions.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🎮 Gameplay & Combat[/h3][list][*][p]Combat rebalanced for a more dynamic and engaging experience.[/p][/*][*][p]Loot distribution adjusted to improve progression and resource management.[/p][/*][*][p]Vegetation now reacts to enemy movement, increasing immersion.[/p][/*][/list][h3]📖 Story & Quests[/h3][list][*][p]Rewritten parts of certain quests for clearer and more coherent storytelling.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed quest-related issues impacting progression.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🐞 Bug Fixes & Miscellaneous[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed animation issues during combat.[/p][/*][*][p]Various small adjustments and stability improvements.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.bug: Fixed cursor display issue on 4K resolutions.

tags.balance_change: Combat rebalanced for a more dynamic and engaging experience.
Loot distribution adjusted to improve progression and resource management.

tags.feature: Vegetation now reacts to enemy movement, increasing immersion.

notes.title: Patch 1.2.0 – The Reboot
notes.content: [h3][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1278860/view/529852487375519775?snr=1_5_9_"]Patch 1.2.0[/url][/h3][p]Welcome to version 1.2.0 of [b]Dice or Die[/b], an essential update marking a turning point in the game's development. This version brings the project closer to its final release with major technical improvements, new narrative content, and in-depth gameplay adjustments.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]🔧 Engine Change & Optimizations[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Complete migration[/b] to Unity 2021.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Significant performance improvements[/b], notably through GPU optimization (vegetation instancing, asset loading, etc.).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Reduced loading times[/b] and improved overall stability.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]🌄 New Environments[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Visual and technical overhaul[/b] of several zones: lighting, vegetation, fog, sound ambiance.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved gameplay zone readability[/b] while preserving the strange, isolated atmosphere of the [b]Dice or Die[/b] world.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]📖 New Storyline & Narrative Structure[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The story has been [b]completely reimagined[/b], with smoother progression, better coherence, and narration better integrated into exploration.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Revamped quests[/b], enriched dialogues, clarified alternative endings.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Implementation of contextual narrative events[/b] tied to specific zones and and discoveries.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]🏕️ Evolving Campsite[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Introduction of an evolving campsite system[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Players can now [b]upgrade their shelter[/b] (rest, storage, comfort), influencing mid-term survival chances.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Progressive visual impact[/b] reflecting the location's evolution throughout the game.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]🎮 Gameplay Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Major revisions to interaction and navigation mechanics[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Crafting, resource management, exploration, and feedback[/b] redesigned for a smoother, more intuitive experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Adjustments to animation timings[/b], trigger zones, and action prompts.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]🐞 Bug Fixes & Miscellaneous Adjustments[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Numerous minor bugs fixed[/b] (translations, textures, UI, quest logic, collisions).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Better balancing of vital needs[/b] (hunger, thirst, fatigue, hope).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved zone detection[/b] for key transitions or events.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Thank you to all players who contributed to this evolution by sharing feedback on Discord, Twitter/X, and via the official website. Your input has helped [b]Dice or Die[/b] reach a major milestone.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]🧭 The final release is approaching… 🔥[/b][/h3]

tags.feature: - Complete migration to Unity 2021.
- Visual and technical overhaul of several zones: lighting, vegetation, fog, sound ambiance.
- The story has been completely reimagined, with smoother progression, better coherence, and narration better integrated into exploration.
- Revamped quests, enriched dialogues, clarified alternative endings.
- Implementation of contextual narrative events tied to specific zones and and discoveries.
- Introduction of an evolving campsite system.
- Players can now upgrade their shelter (rest, storage, comfort), influencing mid-term survival chances.
- Progressive visual impact reflecting the location's evolution throughout the game.

tags.bug: - Numerous minor bugs fixed (translations, textures, UI, quest logic, collisions).

tags.balance_change: - Better balancing of vital needs (hunger, thirst, fatigue, hope).

notes.title: Di[c]e - Dice or Die update 1.1.7
notes.content:
A new feature appears to make the Action Point system more readable:
When you have used action points, the gauge will turn purple and gradually fill up, letting you know exactly how much time is left in order to recover your action points.

Some bugs have been fixed and some optimizations are also included in this update.

notes.title: Di[c]e - Dice or Die update 1.1.6
notes.content:
The Menhir quest has been updated  to regain lost components if you made a mistake in the order of activation.
You just need to use the ice stone.

Cheat's console now got  three new entries:
As usual type the keys "c" "h" "e" "a" "t" on your keyboard to open the console then, enter one of the following codes:
- "Gold" to receive gold.
- "Silver" to receive silver.
- "Bronze" to receive bronze.

Use sparingly =)

Cheers!

notes.title: Di[c]e - Dice or Die update 1.1.5
notes.content:
A new, much faster saving system is rolling out!
It remains compatible with the old system which means you don't lose your progress.

Some freezes may occur when creating a new game during the tutorial windows. They are completely normal: this is where the magic happens to give you a smoother gaming experience afterwards.

Cheers!

notes.title: Di[c]e - Dice or Die update 1.1.4
notes.content:
Di[c]E - Dice or Die update 1.1.4 :
This update introduces the cheat and debug console.
In game, successively press the following keys on your keyboard: "c" "h" "e" "a" "t".
The console will appear at the top of the screen.
Enter one of the following codes:
- "God Mode" = Reset all vital values to 100
- " Fast Travel" = Activate all fast travel zones
- "Bag" =  Add a bag to the inventory

Other codes can be added at your request.
Alternatively, if a bug occurs, you can try to unblock yourself with one of the debugging tools accessible from the same console:
-  "Debug Trigger" =  Reactivates the areas if they are no longer accessible.
- "Debug Mouse" = Reactivate movement
- "Unblock" = Allows you to unlock the player if it remains blocked.

Finally, a plant spawn system appears. Randomly, between the 7th and the 12th days, plants will reappear in the different places of the island allowing you to restock your supplies and to concoct recipes!

tags.feature: This update introduces the cheat and debug console.
Finally, a plant spawn system appears.

notes.title: Di[c]e - Dice or Die update 1.1.0
notes.content:
Di[c]E - Dice or Die update 1.1.0 is live!

As promised it brings a hard mode.

Normal: The settings remain unchanged to what you are used to.
Hard: Vital parameters drop 30% faster, diseases affect you 25% faster, enemies have 30% more health, you start the adventure in a worse general state and there is no water when you arrive at the camp.

The hard mode is still being refined, it is doable but ... it is hard for new players!

If you resume your current game, it will be in normal mode, as before.
To try the adventure in difficult, you have to restart a new game and choose the appropriate level of difficulty.

I am of course always at your disposal to make the changes you want during the next update which will take place in the coming days!

Have a good game, have fun and ... Cheers!

notes.title: Check out the latest update!
notes.content:
Di[c]E has been available in early access for two months!

As promised during this early access phase, we have listened to our players who have been heavily involved in the development of the title. We have worked hard to make your ideas a reality!

[b]Thank you ![/b]

This ninth update includes a lot of changes that further improve the gaming experience:
- The hero can now run and move stealthily.
- A camera zoom system has been set up to adjust the view to your liking.
- 7 new enemies appear on the island, including a boss!
- A tutorial has appeared.
- During combat, the camera offers dynamic changes in 3D.
- The crafting system and camp equipment have evolved to become more accessible.
- The difficulty of the game has been reduced.
- Magic effects have been improved.
- The minimap is accessible all the time and has been reworked.
- The gamedesign has been changed to make early game more accessible to new players.

All this without compromising the fluidity and optimization of the Di[c]E - Dice or Die experience.

The new gameplay trailer highlights most of these new features:
[previewyoutube=ceLEBLcL2D8;full][/previewyoutube]

As usual during this early access, we are at your disposal to implement your ideas into the game experience!

We wish you lots of fun and a great adventure on the island!

To your dice!
